lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current official address table lists this OUSG_InstantManager under active Ethereum OUSG deployments and explicitly describes it as the ondo.finance investor instant buy/redeem entry point. Official current OUSG overview describes 24/7 USDC/PYUSD subscriptions and redemptions and management-fee waiver until January 1, 2027. The separate Legacy section explicitly deprecates old manager 0x2826989983e3a66F0622132D019c2Ae173eb6A43 on April 7, 2025; that deployment is not admitted. No reviewed official source announces this current manager or OUSG wind-down/team disbandment. These are lifecycle/product maintenance signals, not DAU or manager-specific vaultTVL evidence.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official current Ethereum address table explicitly binds OUSG_InstantManager to this exact address and links its Etherscan source. Verified constructor arguments bind immutable rwaToken OUSG 0x1B19C19393e2d034D8Ff31ff34c81252FcBbee92 and rousg 0x54043c656f0faD0652D9Ae2603cdF347c5578d00. Source is a directly deployed constructor contract, and Sourcify reports isProxy=false; configurable router/oracle/compliance/ID/fee/limiter dependencies are not treated as separately admitted targets.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full exact-address ABI and compiler-bound sources fetched from Sourcify v2 for this official manager. Sourcify creation/runtime both report match, not exact_match; Etherscan separately labels source Exact Match. Record both services literally without upgrading Sourcify match status. Full 56-function inventory retained including inherited BaseRWAManager/AccessControl methods; not a generic ERC20 ABI and not a legacy-manager repository substitute. No fresh RPC or independent compilation/execution verification.

sourceSemantics.evidence: OUSG_InstantManager subscribe and redeem are external nonReentrant investor entry points, not onlyRole admin mint methods. _processSubscription/_processRedemption enforce accepted tokens, pause flags, ondoCompliance, nonzero OndoID, configured oracle minimum price, USD minima, fee limits, per-user/global rate limits and caller minimum output. subscribe mints to sender after pulling deposit; redeem burns sender OUSG and pays sender through configured router. Rebasing variants explicitly wrap/unwrap rOUSG on behalf of caller and preserve the same guards. _adminProcessSubscription separately requires ADMIN_SUBSCRIPTION_ROLE and is excluded. Legal qualified-access restrictions are explicit, never inferred permissionless access.

selectedFunctions.label: Ondo Finance OUSG InstantManager redeem
warnings: OUSG is a Qualified Access product, not an unrestricted stablecoin. Ordinary investor entry points require completed onboarding/KYC, both accredited-investor and qualified-purchaser eligibility, jurisdiction eligibility, nonzero OndoID and compliance checks. No whitelist or legal restriction is bypassed.

Only tokens accepted by this manager configuration may be deposited or received. Caller token balances/allowances, configured oracle minimum price, minimum subscription/redemption, fees, user/global rate limits, pause state and router liquidity apply. Current configuration is not freshly attested.

subscribe mints OUSG to the caller after transferring accepted deposit tokens; subscribeRebasingOUSG additionally wraps into rOUSG. redeem transfers/burns caller OUSG; redeemRebasingOUSG transfers/unwraps caller rOUSG before burning OUSG and paying the accepted receiving token. This is not adminSubscribe or direct role-only OUSG mint.

Use a meaningful minimumRwaReceived/minimumRousgReceived/minimumTokenReceived in the output token decimals. Input token/rOUSG and underlying OUSG decimals differ; oracle conversion, fees and rebasing-share rounding apply. No caller deadline.

The current official manager is 0x93358db73B6cd4b98D89c8F5f230E81a95c2643a; legacy 0x2826989983e3a66F0622132D019c2Ae173eb6A43 is officially deprecated and not supported. Manager source is non-proxy; its configurable dependencies and rOUSG token may change behavior.

All four calls are nonpayable and require zero native value. Source/explorer binding is not a fresh runtime/RPC, execution, funding, liquidity or financial-safety guarantee and grants no API-key authority. No DAU or manager-vaultTVL claim.
